# Rev

> > Rev provides AI-powered speech-to-text services including transcription, captions, and subtitles through human and automated solutions, with specialized tools for legal, education, and marketing professionals.

Rev offers both consumer transcription services and developer APIs (Rev.ai) for speech recognition integration. The platform serves diverse industries with products like Rev Insights for legal document analysis, SmartDepo for depositions, and accessibility solutions compliant with ADA and HIPAA standards.

## Key Topics

- Rev.ai API
- Speech-to-text transcription
- Closed captions and subtitles
- Legal transcription and Rev Insights
- AI transcription services
- Accessibility (ADA/HIPAA compliance)
- Avid Media Composer integration
- ScriptSync workflow
- Speech recognition API
- Rev Mobile App
- Legal tech and SmartDepo
- Academic transcription
- Content creation and SEO
- Multilingual transcription
- Video editing workflows

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Academic Transcription Services For Research](https://www.rev.com/solutions/education): Academic transcription for lectures, research, ADA/HIPAA compliant solutions
- [Speech to Text Transcription for Marketing](https://www.rev.com/solutions/marketing): Marketing transcription services for market research, SEO, and content creation
- [Customer Reviews for Our Speech-to-Text Services](https://www.rev.com/reviews): Customer testimonials and reviews for Rev transcription services from 1M+ users
- [Greening Law Case Study: Sentence Reduced By 30 Years](https://www.rev.com/customers/greening-law-group): Case study: Greening Law Group used Rev Insights to analyze 1M+ documents
